cl_f_L_per_hr.note: Approximate published steady-state apparent oral clearance for adagrasib.

t_half_hr.note: Approximate published elimination half-life for adagrasib.

tau_hr.note: All planned dose levels are administered twice daily.

fu.note: Calculated from approximately 98.3% plasma protein binding.

ic50_nM.note: Representative estimate of cellular KRAS G12C inhibitory potency; the protocol does not specify a cellular assay or IC50.

mw.note: Molecular weight of adagrasib, in g/mol.
